name: naos-governance
description: Codex operator interface for NAOS-Governance projects.

interface.shortDescription: Operate an installed NAOS kit from Codex.
interface.longDescription: NAOS Governance provides Codex skills and references for using an already-installed project-local NAOS kit. It guides adoption, audit, learning, evidence, and adapter-coherence workflows without replacing repository evidence or silently enabling MCP, memory writes, hooks, provider calls, approvals, or compliance claims.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the NAOS Governance plugin to inspect the current repository, confirm whether NAOS is installed, and recommend the next governed command sequence.
